patches_modified.description: Makes Kick's dark background pure black for OLED screens, optionally with near-black cards and sheets. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps live streams and videos playing as audio when you leave Kick, using Kick's own audio notification. A second switch turns off the automatic picture-in-picture window. On by default, as on Twitch. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Bypass VOD ad sessions
patches_modified.description: Experimental: uses the original VOD URL instead of requesting a separate ad-session manifest. Does not remove ads stitched into live streams. Enable in Lurk settings after patching.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes Kick's name in the launcher and Android settings.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known campaign and advertising click parameters from kick.com links in share sheets. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Kick's current share links are already clean.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Kick under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Sharing sign-in with Kick's broadcaster app may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Kick opens on instead of Home: Browse or Following. Links and notifications still open what they point to. Starts on Home. Choose another in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling. A lower starting ceiling can be set for mobile data in Lurk settings > Playback; it's off until then.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection, Insider and Datadog initialization/events, Mux/Datazoom player analytics and PAL nonce requests. Playback API requests remain necessary to obtain streams. Restart Kick after changing this setting. This does not remove video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Starts Kick's feed previews switched off. Existing preferences and Kick's own autoplay switch keep working. Does not change intentionally opened streams.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides Clips tabs in Browse, channels and categories, and the popular-clips row on channels. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides the featured carousel, recommended streams and categories rows on Home, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide KICKs tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides the chat gift-shop button, KICKs purchase button and leaderboard tipping prompt.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides pinned messages, polls and predictions, goals, sub and gift messages, host messages, reward redemptions, event and drops banners, pinned KICKs gifts and celebration prompts, each with its own switch. Other chat messages are unchanged. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompt
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides channel Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the leaderboard gift-subscription prompt. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Kick's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID, ad attribution and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete is meant for the channel's moderators. A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_modified.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds optional 7TV emotes to chat, the native picker and autocomplete, with zero-width layers and live set updates. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io, subscribes to set IDs at events.7tv.io and loads images from cdn.7tv.app. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch that shows the channel's 7TV emotes, and 7TV's global emotes, in live chat. When on, it sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io and loads emote images from cdn.7tv.app. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. After restarting, Airship does not start; this may affect push notifications. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. Push notifications stop too, since Rumble only starts its push service (Airship) with consent. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Off by default; needs a signed-in account.

patches_modified.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. When none can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_modified.name: Block client ads
patches_modified.description: Declines ads handled by Twitch's native client ad eligibility check using its existing not eligible result. Does not remove ads stitched into streams by the server or guarantee ad-free playback.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Hides Twitch's automatic cookie consent notice without accepting it or changing saved vendor consent. Manual consent settings stay available. Use Disable analytics to block tracking.

patches_modified.name: Block display ads
patches_modified.description: Blocks the ad requests that Block client ads doesn't cover: stream display ads (squeezeback and lower third), audio ads, multi-format ad pods, the Following headliner, feed display and video ads and brand surveys, in both the native and React Native parts of the app. Each request gets the failure or no-ad answer Twitch already handles. Sponsorship and paid-promotion labels are kept. Ads stitched into the stream by the server still play.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name shown under Twitch's launcher icon and in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat appearance
patches_modified.description: Adds chat look settings: text size, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native and React Native live chat and history, plus native VOD chat replay.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds chat look settings: text size, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native and React Native live chat and history, plus native VOD chat replay.
patches_modified.previous_description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that scrolls live chat messages right to left across the top of the video in landscape (danmaku), as plain white text with the sender's name. Off until turned on in Lurk settings, with choices for speed and number of lines. Native live channels only: not React Native chat, VODs or chat replay. The overlay never takes touches.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of it, the way Twitch already shows it on chat history, in 24-hour or 12-hour format. Whispers are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known Twitch attribution and campaign parameters from shared links and copied share text. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Covers native and React Native sharing.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Twitch under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Amazon sign-in and verified app links may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Twitch's native and React Native Spade event uploads, denies local analytics SDK consent, enables Branch's limited tracking mode, blocks Crashlytics uploads, Nielsen audience pings and Sprig surveys, and prevents Sentry initialization. Watch progress, viewing statistics and rewards may stop updating. Restart Twitch after changing this setting. Playback requests still run.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops the next recommended video and React Native feed clip from playing automatically, and defaults feed previews to Never. Manual Play and saved feed preview choices keep working.

patches_modified.name: Fix notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app register for push notifications. Firebase only accepts Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, and refuses the re-signed app, so its registration requests send the original ones.

patches_modified.name: Fix stuck start screen
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch when its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds. Twitch waits for Branch's link lookup before it routes, and when that never answers, it stays on a blank start screen until it's closed, unpatched Twitch included.

patches_modified.name: Force ExoPlayer
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that plays live channels and videos with the ExoPlayer backend Twitch still ships instead of Amazon IVS. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. Clips, encrypted streams and React Native players stay on IVS. Lurk patches that hook IVS, such as Normal latency, Mute stitched ads and Show video stats, don't act on ExoPlayer.

patches_modified.name: Hide Bits tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides chat Bits buttons, Bits purchase cards, the cheering tray and one-tap Bits controls. Keeps normal chat and Bits messages sent by other viewers.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides the Clips discovery tab on Home and the Clips tab on native channel profiles. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_modified.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide player buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Subscribe and Gift a Sub prompts, Turbo promotions and the native Turbo signup/startup offer. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator and legitimate account entitlements.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Twitch's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar position
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Player gestures
patches_modified.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_modified.name: Playlist proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty. Videos and clips are not proxied.

patches_modified.name: Refresh stream
patches_modified.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_modified.name: Tablet layout
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Third-party badges
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native and React Native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_modified.name: Use native player
patches_modified.description: Always opens live channels in Twitch's native player, never the React Native "Ultralight" player a server experiment can switch some users to. Most Lurk playback, chat and ad patches hook the native player.

patches_modified.name: VOD chapters
patches_modified.description: Adds a Chapters button to the native video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one through Twitch's own seek. The list comes from Twitch's public data, fetched with the app's client ID. On by default.

patches_modified.name: Watch without signing in
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch without an account instead of stopping at the Log In / Sign Up screen, using Twitch's own signed-out mode. Streams, videos and chat can be watched; following, chatting and other account actions still ask you to sign in. Signed-in use is unchanged.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Makes Kick's dark background pure black for OLED screens, optionally with near-black cards and sheets. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps live streams and videos playing as audio when you leave Kick, using Kick's own audio notification. A second switch turns off the automatic picture-in-picture window. On by default, as on Twitch. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Bypass VOD ad sessions
patches_modified.description: Experimental: uses the original VOD URL instead of requesting a separate ad-session manifest. Does not remove ads stitched into live streams. Enable in Lurk settings after patching.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes Kick's name in the launcher and Android settings.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known campaign and advertising click parameters from kick.com links in share sheets. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Kick's current share links are already clean.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Kick under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Sharing sign-in with Kick's broadcaster app may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Kick opens on instead of Home: Browse or Following. Links and notifications still open what they point to. Starts on Home. Choose another in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling. A lower starting ceiling can be set for mobile data in Lurk settings > Playback; it's off until then.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection, Insider and Datadog initialization/events, Mux/Datazoom player analytics and PAL nonce requests. Playback API requests remain necessary to obtain streams. Restart Kick after changing this setting. This does not remove video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Starts Kick's feed previews switched off. Existing preferences and Kick's own autoplay switch keep working. Does not change intentionally opened streams.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides Clips tabs in Browse, channels and categories, and the popular-clips row on channels. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.description: Installs Twitch under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Amazon sign-in and verified app links may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Twitch's native and React Native Spade event uploads, denies local analytics SDK consent, enables Branch's limited tracking mode, blocks Crashlytics uploads, Nielsen audience pings and Sprig surveys, and prevents Sentry initialization. Watch progress, viewing statistics and rewards may stop updating. Restart Twitch after changing this setting. Playback requests still run.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops the next recommended video and React Native feed clip from playing automatically, and defaults feed previews to Never. Manual Play and saved feed preview choices keep working.

patches_modified.name: Fix notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app register for push notifications. Firebase only accepts Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, and refuses the re-signed app, so its registration requests send the original ones.

patches_modified.name: Fix stuck start screen
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch when its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds. Twitch waits for Branch's link lookup before it routes, and when that never answers, it stays on a blank start screen until it's closed, unpatched Twitch included.

patches_modified.name: Force ExoPlayer
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that plays live channels and videos with the ExoPlayer backend Twitch still ships instead of Amazon IVS. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. Clips, encrypted streams and React Native players stay on IVS. Lurk patches that hook IVS, such as Normal latency, Mute stitched ads and Show video stats, don't act on ExoPlayer.

patches_modified.name: Hide Bits tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides chat Bits buttons, Bits purchase cards, the cheering tray and one-tap Bits controls. Keeps normal chat and Bits messages sent by other viewers.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides the Clips discovery tab on Home and the Clips tab on native channel profiles. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_modified.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide player buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Subscribe and Gift a Sub prompts, Turbo promotions and the native Turbo signup/startup offer. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator and legitimate account entitlements.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Twitch's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar position
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Player gestures
patches_modified.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_modified.name: Playlist proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty. Videos and clips are not proxied.

patches_modified.name: Refresh stream
patches_modified.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_modified.name: Tablet layout
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Third-party badges
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native and React Native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_modified.name: Use native player
patches_modified.description: Always opens live channels in Twitch's native player, never the React Native "Ultralight" player a server experiment can switch some users to. Most Lurk playback, chat and ad patches hook the native player.

patches_modified.name: VOD chapters
patches_modified.description: Adds a Chapters button to the native video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one through Twitch's own seek. The list comes from Twitch's public data, fetched with the app's client ID. On by default.

patches_modified.name: Watch without signing in
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch without an account instead of stopping at the Log In / Sign Up screen, using Twitch's own signed-out mode. Streams, videos and chat can be watched; following, chatting and other account actions still ask you to sign in. Signed-in use is unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches_modified.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.1, skips the uncertified-device screen, and prefers synthesized navigation speech with early Google TTS startup and the existing audio fallback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.1 and prefers synthesized navigation speech with the existing audio fallback.

patches_added.name: Hide tab badges
patches_added.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_added.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop live connection logging
patches_added.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches_added.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Stop MQTT logging
patches_removed.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_removed.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Native Bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Native Bubbles needs Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Open your gallery app
patches_modified.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. What you pick then opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches_added.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black theme
patches_modified.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Cards and menus stay a shade lighter than the page. Turn on Black cards in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance to make them black too, and Lines between posts there for a thin gray line between posts in the feed. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps Facebook's blue on links, buttons, switches and the selected tab for a color you like better. Nothing changes until you pick one. Pick a color in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on the pages where Facebook blocks them, so you can keep a copy of what's on screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches_modified.description: Games you play inside Facebook show no ads, so you can keep playing without breaks. A rewarded ad gives no reward unless you also turn on the switch that counts it as watched. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu.

patches_modified.name: Block ad telemetry
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install after seeing ads, and stops several of the ways it sends your phone's advertising ID, so less of what you do feeds its ad tracking. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches_modified.description: Stops the jobs Facebook runs in the background to download ads, and the model it ranks them with, before you ever see them. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Facebook within ten minutes, or any time with No time limit on, so you don't lose what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Block promotional notifications
patches_modified.description: Blocks the kinds of notification you pick, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays, so you get fewer pings you don't care about. Messages, friend requests, comments and login alerts always come through. Starts off. Turn on the kinds you want in Hushfacebook settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Block screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats and everywhere else, so it can't react to it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Facebook's chat list
patches_modified.description: Tidies Chats inside Facebook. One switch empties the row of notes and who's active above your chats, and another removes promotional banners like the one asking you to turn on notifications. A third takes the Meta AI button off the search row and the search screen. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Save button, the speaker button or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sheet options
patches_modified.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Default comment order
patches_modified.description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of what Facebook picks. Lower saves data, higher looks sharper. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a quality in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable Audience Network
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone. Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates, which a patched app can't take anyway. It isn't selected by default because once it's installed, a build without it can't install over it. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Don't save search history
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook from adding what you search for to your search history, so there's nothing to clear by hand. Searches already there stay until you delete them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched, so it learns less about what you watch. Reels you've already seen may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Download any photo
patches_modified.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel and a Download row to its More menu, so you can keep reels on your phone. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music, so you can keep the ones you like. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, so you can save them to watch later. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Following feed on Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, asks Facebook for one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages) instead. When that filter has nothing new, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, so pair it with Hide "Suggested for you" posts and Hide Reels in the feed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Force dark mode
patches_modified.description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says. Useful on tablets, where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Frame step
patches_modified.description: With a reel or video paused, a tap on its right side steps one frame forward and a tap on its left side one frame back, so you can stop on the exact moment you want. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts and reels Facebook marked as made with AI, posts creators labeled as AI, posts with Meta's AI characters and Meta AI cards in the feed. Only the Meta AI cards switch starts on. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections and the Muse card in Facebook's Menu, so the Menu has fewer ads for Meta's products. Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu. A switch there, off by default, also hides the Meta AI shortcut, and a list there hides the Menu tiles and Help and Settings rows you pick, such as Gaming or Orders and payments.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts, so you read what people actually wrote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches_modified.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and Ask Meta AI prompts from search results, and stops suggestions from sending your search to Meta AI. You get plain results for people, groups, Pages and posts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts, for a cleaner feed. The post and its buttons stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Meta's pushes for its other products, such as Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine, so you see fewer sales pitches. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Meta's other products.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends, so the feed sticks to posts. A reel a friend posts stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories tray
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the feed, the stories between posts, or the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home, so you reach posts sooner. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches_modified.description: Removes the shopping cards that affiliate links add to reels, feed posts and comments, plus Shop now cards on reels, so you see fewer sales pitches while you scroll. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide carrier data banners
patches_modified.description: On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar with its buy mobile data button, or the purple Free mode bar, so the feed gets that space back. Both switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide post prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Three more switches there, Hide the Follow link on posts, Hide counts on posts and Hide the reaction preview on posts, start off.

patches_modified.name: Hide posts by words
patches_modified.description: Hides feed posts with words you list, or from people, Pages or sites you list, so you skip topics you're tired of. Photo, video, link and colored background posts can go too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: People you chat with in chats that open inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages, so you can read now and reply later. Replying may still show you've read it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt, so reels play without the interruption. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide seen posts
patches_modified.description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days, so you see something new. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches_modified.description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results, so you see more of what people are selling. Listings people post stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind, so you see fewer ads. It also keeps the floating ad button off an ad's comments. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page, so you only see what they posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches_modified.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and ads in the middle of videos, so you can watch without interruptions. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, so you see the people, Pages and posts you searched for. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches_modified.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories shows only what people posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches_modified.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads, like "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know" and suggested groups, so you see more from people you follow. Most of its switches are on by default. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, and the "Find friends from contacts" card, so the Stories tray sticks to people you know. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab badges
patches_modified.description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon, so the app nags you less. Notifications still arrive and still show in the Notifications tab. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide tabs
patches_modified.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar, such as Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events, so the bar only has what you use. Each page stays in the Menu. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches_modified.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens straight on posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats when Messenger is already installed. A patched Facebook may not see that Messenger is there, so it keeps showing the card. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, off the tab bar, so Reels isn't one tap away. Reels in your feed and reel links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches_modified.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, so it stops calling for your attention. Other tabs keep theirs. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes, so you can write without anyone watching. Your messages send as usual. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches_modified.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook sending its usage reports in the background and skips the learning jobs it runs on your phone, so less about how you use the app leaves it. A second switch holds back the camera roll processing that uploads your photos and details about them for sharing suggestions. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, so the settings are easy to find. A Saved row joins it while the Saved shortcut switch is on, a Watch history row while the Watch history shortcut switch is, and a Free stuff row, Marketplace's free listings, while the Free stuff shortcut switch under Marketplace is. On by default. Turn it off with Settings row in Menu in Hushfacebook settings > Menu, unless it's the last way into the settings still on.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches_modified.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install next to your patched Facebook. Without it, Android refuses them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches_modified.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep post dates
patches_modified.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name, so you can always tell how old a post is. Facebook's newer header can swap it for rotating details, and on some phones the line goes blank. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Keep the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: A speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels, even after Facebook restarts, so you don't set it every time. Pick normal speed to go back. On by default. A second switch for feed and Watch videos starts off. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Marketplace only
patches_modified.description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. The Events only switch does the same for Events once you pin Events in Facebook's Customize the bar. Both start off. Turn one on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Gives Facebook the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, so it matches your phone. Dark mode takes them everywhere, and light mode on its grays, blues and selected tab. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing the switch or whether Messenger is installed or enabled, so call routing updates.

patches_modified.name: Open comments at full height
patches_modified.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up, on posts, videos, reels and stories. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet instead of the split view. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Open comments with a gesture
patches_modified.description: Open a reel's comments with a double tap or a long press, on the sheet the Comment button opens, instead of liking or holding, and a feed post's with a long press on its photo or name line. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links in your own browser instead of Facebook's built-in one, without Facebook tracking the click. Facebook pages still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Links. A second switch, on by default under Privacy, stops Facebook's browser keeping a history of the links you open in it.

patches_modified.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches_modified.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick when you start it from its icon, so you can skip the feed. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_modified.description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, and lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Remember what you watch, a second switch, keeps a list on your phone of the reels, videos and stories you watched, under Recently watched. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality
patches_modified.description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links, where two switches that start off also take away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat and the row of people Facebook suggests sending to.

patches_modified.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches_modified.description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches_modified.name: Skip silent parts
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and stories past the silent stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback. With Resume long videos patched too, a video's menu can keep the silent parts in that one video.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch puts it at the top instead, as older Facebook had it. Another lets it slide away as you scroll, and two more keep the tab bar or the top bar on screen instead. One gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too, and one makes the top bar and the tab bar see-through. Another hides the phone's status bar on the main screen until you swipe down from the top. Three more take the Messenger button, its unread count or the Facebook logo out of the top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Writing.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches_modified.description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off auto-translation
patches_modified.description: Shows posts and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a reel or video from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu, photos and new screens at once, without the slide or zoom between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. A second switch, Use the icon at the top of Home, puts your pick at the top of Home too. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Upload Stories in HD
patches_modified.description: Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard, so they can come out sharper. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches_modified.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Use the system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you. Stories you watch to the end show as watched on this phone only, until that person posts a new one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: 既読なし閲覧のメッセージ別既読操作
patches_added.description: 受信した通常メッセージの下に、そこまでを既読にする操作を追加します。

patches_added.name: 既読なし閲覧中の手動既読入口
patches_added.description: 選択したメッセージと現在のトーク全体を、公式の既読処理へ渡す入口を追加します。

patches_added.name: Use the system photo picker
patches_added.description: Adds an entry to Instagram's gallery sheet that opens Android's own photo picker when you make a post, so you pick from your photos and any cloud gallery and Instagram only gets what you choose. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons off the top of a chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a like
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Back leaves Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches_modified.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Change the like animation
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Clear the media cache
patches_modified.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches_modified.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Data saver
patches_modified.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Don't save recent searches
