patches_modified.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Download voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Emoji style
patches_modified.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_modified.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Font
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Full resolution photos
patches_modified.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_modified.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home does. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels) and Feed (Full screen Home).

patches_modified.name: Glass tab bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_modified.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide Follow on feed posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Follow on stories
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches_modified.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off. Find them in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile tabs
patches_modified.description: Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches_modified.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_modified.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the followers and following lists, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back, suggested threads and people, and the Featured section off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, or the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_modified.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches_modified.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create and Profile, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages or Ghost mode button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Repost button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Share button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Threads button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide the comment emoji row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide the home feed
patches_modified.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the notes row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide the search bar in Messages
patches_modified.description: Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide your active status
patches_modified.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: HushGram launch screen
patches_modified.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: HushGram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Install next to Instagram
patches_modified.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep in chat
patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Lock your messages
patches_modified.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Long press to zoom
patches_modified.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Loop a story
patches_modified.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Message box buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Open comments without the keyboard
patches_modified.description: Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Profile posts as a list
patches_modified.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Remove build expired popup
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Rounded post corners
patches_modified.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, at a small or large size. Stories, profiles, Explore and Reels stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Save profile picture
patches_modified.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Saved on your profile
patches_modified.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: See who a story mentions
patches_modified.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches_modified.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Show a story's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Show all recent searches
patches_modified.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Show hidden like counts
patches_modified.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Show when someone was last active
patches_modified.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Spoof location
patches_modified.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Start Home on Following
patches_modified.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches_modified.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Start stories with sound
patches_modified.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches_modified.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping for 15 minutes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches_modified.description: Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe to create
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe up to reply
patches_modified.description: Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Story ring size
patches_modified.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Swipe left to open the profile
patches_modified.description: Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches_modified.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches_modified.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches_modified.description: Sends the video stories you post at up to 1080 pixels wide instead of 720, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Use the system photo picker
patches_modified.description: Adds an entry to Instagram's gallery sheet that opens Android's own photo picker when you make a post, so you pick from your photos and any cloud gallery and Instagram only gets what you choose. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches_modified.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: View live anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches_added.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black theme
patches_modified.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Cards and menus stay a shade lighter than the page. Turn on Black cards in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance to make them black too, and Lines between posts there for a thin gray line between posts in the feed. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps Facebook's blue on links, buttons, switches and the selected tab for a color you like better. Nothing changes until you pick one. Pick a color in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on the pages where Facebook blocks them, so you can keep a copy of what's on screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches_modified.description: Games you play inside Facebook show no ads, so you can keep playing without breaks. A rewarded ad gives no reward unless you also turn on the switch that counts it as watched. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu.

patches_modified.name: Block ad telemetry
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install after seeing ads, and stops several of the ways it sends your phone's advertising ID, so less of what you do feeds its ad tracking. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches_modified.description: Stops the jobs Facebook runs in the background to download ads, and the model it ranks them with, before you ever see them. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Facebook within ten minutes, or any time with No time limit on, so you don't lose what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Block promotional notifications
patches_modified.description: Blocks the kinds of notification you pick, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays, so you get fewer pings you don't care about. Messages, friend requests, comments and login alerts always come through. Starts off. Turn on the kinds you want in Hushfacebook settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Block screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats and everywhere else, so it can't react to it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Facebook's chat list
patches_modified.description: Tidies Chats inside Facebook. One switch empties the row of notes and who's active above your chats, and another removes promotional banners like the one asking you to turn on notifications. A third takes the Meta AI button off the search row and the search screen. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Save button, the speaker button or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sheet options
patches_modified.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Default comment order
patches_modified.description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of what Facebook picks. Lower saves data, higher looks sharper. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a quality in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable Audience Network
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone. Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates, which a patched app can't take anyway. It isn't selected by default because once it's installed, a build without it can't install over it. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Don't save search history
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook from adding what you search for to your search history, so there's nothing to clear by hand. Searches already there stay until you delete them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched, so it learns less about what you watch. Reels you've already seen may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Download any photo
patches_modified.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel and a Download row to its More menu, so you can keep reels on your phone. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music, so you can keep the ones you like. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, so you can save them to watch later. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Following feed on Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, asks Facebook for one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages) instead. When that filter has nothing new, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, so pair it with Hide "Suggested for you" posts and Hide Reels in the feed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Force dark mode
patches_modified.description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says. Useful on tablets, where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Frame step
patches_modified.description: With a reel or video paused, a tap on its right side steps one frame forward and a tap on its left side one frame back, so you can stop on the exact moment you want. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts and reels Facebook marked as made with AI, posts creators labeled as AI, posts with Meta's AI characters and Meta AI cards in the feed. Only the Meta AI cards switch starts on. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections and the Muse card in Facebook's Menu, so the Menu has fewer ads for Meta's products. Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu. A switch there, off by default, also hides the Meta AI shortcut, and a list there hides the Menu tiles and Help and Settings rows you pick, such as Gaming or Orders and payments.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts, so you read what people actually wrote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches_modified.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and Ask Meta AI prompts from search results, and stops suggestions from sending your search to Meta AI. You get plain results for people, groups, Pages and posts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts, for a cleaner feed. The post and its buttons stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Meta's pushes for its other products, such as Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine, so you see fewer sales pitches. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Meta's other products.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends, so the feed sticks to posts. A reel a friend posts stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories tray
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the feed, the stories between posts, or the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home, so you reach posts sooner. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches_modified.description: Removes the shopping cards that affiliate links add to reels, feed posts and comments, plus Shop now cards on reels, so you see fewer sales pitches while you scroll. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide carrier data banners
patches_modified.description: On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar with its buy mobile data button, or the purple Free mode bar, so the feed gets that space back. Both switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide post prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Three more switches there, Hide the Follow link on posts, Hide counts on posts and Hide the reaction preview on posts, start off.

patches_modified.name: Hide posts by words
patches_modified.description: Hides feed posts with words you list, or from people, Pages or sites you list, so you skip topics you're tired of. Photo, video, link and colored background posts can go too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: People you chat with in chats that open inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages, so you can read now and reply later. Replying may still show you've read it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt, so reels play without the interruption. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide seen posts
patches_modified.description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days, so you see something new. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches_modified.description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results, so you see more of what people are selling. Listings people post stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind, so you see fewer ads. It also keeps the floating ad button off an ad's comments. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page, so you only see what they posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches_modified.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and ads in the middle of videos, so you can watch without interruptions. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, so you see the people, Pages and posts you searched for. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches_modified.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories shows only what people posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches_modified.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads, like "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know" and suggested groups, so you see more from people you follow. Most of its switches are on by default. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, and the "Find friends from contacts" card, so the Stories tray sticks to people you know. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab badges
patches_modified.description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon, so the app nags you less. Notifications still arrive and still show in the Notifications tab. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide tabs
patches_modified.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar, such as Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events, so the bar only has what you use. Each page stays in the Menu. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches_modified.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens straight on posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats when Messenger is already installed. A patched Facebook may not see that Messenger is there, so it keeps showing the card. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, off the tab bar, so Reels isn't one tap away. Reels in your feed and reel links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches_modified.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, so it stops calling for your attention. Other tabs keep theirs. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes, so you can write without anyone watching. Your messages send as usual. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches_modified.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook sending its usage reports in the background and skips the learning jobs it runs on your phone, so less about how you use the app leaves it. A second switch holds back the camera roll processing that uploads your photos and details about them for sharing suggestions. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, so the settings are easy to find. A Saved row joins it while the Saved shortcut switch is on, a Watch history row while the Watch history shortcut switch is, and a Free stuff row, Marketplace's free listings, while the Free stuff shortcut switch under Marketplace is. On by default. Turn it off with Settings row in Menu in Hushfacebook settings > Menu, unless it's the last way into the settings still on.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches_modified.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install next to your patched Facebook. Without it, Android refuses them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches_modified.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep post dates
patches_modified.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name, so you can always tell how old a post is. Facebook's newer header can swap it for rotating details, and on some phones the line goes blank. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Keep the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: A speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels, even after Facebook restarts, so you don't set it every time. Pick normal speed to go back. On by default. A second switch for feed and Watch videos starts off. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Marketplace only
patches_modified.description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. The Events only switch does the same for Events once you pin Events in Facebook's Customize the bar. Both start off. Turn one on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Gives Facebook the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, so it matches your phone. Dark mode takes them everywhere, and light mode on its grays, blues and selected tab. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing the switch or whether Messenger is installed or enabled, so call routing updates.

patches_modified.name: Open comments at full height
patches_modified.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up, on posts, videos, reels and stories. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet instead of the split view. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Open comments with a gesture
patches_modified.description: Open a reel's comments with a double tap or a long press, on the sheet the Comment button opens, instead of liking or holding, and a feed post's with a long press on its photo or name line. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links in your own browser instead of Facebook's built-in one, without Facebook tracking the click. Facebook pages still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Links. A second switch, on by default under Privacy, stops Facebook's browser keeping a history of the links you open in it.

patches_modified.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches_modified.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick when you start it from its icon, so you can skip the feed. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_modified.description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, and lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Remember what you watch, a second switch, keeps a list on your phone of the reels, videos and stories you watched, under Recently watched. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality
patches_modified.description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links, where two switches that start off also take away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat and the row of people Facebook suggests sending to.

patches_modified.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches_modified.description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches_modified.name: Skip silent parts
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and stories past the silent stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback. With Resume long videos patched too, a video's menu can keep the silent parts in that one video.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch puts it at the top instead, as older Facebook had it. Another lets it slide away as you scroll, and two more keep the tab bar or the top bar on screen instead. One gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too, and one makes the top bar and the tab bar see-through. Another hides the phone's status bar on the main screen until you swipe down from the top. Three more take the Messenger button, its unread count or the Facebook logo out of the top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Writing.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches_modified.description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off auto-translation
patches_modified.description: Shows posts and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a reel or video from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu, photos and new screens at once, without the slide or zoom between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. A second switch, Use the icon at the top of Home, puts your pick at the top of Home too. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Upload Stories in HD
patches_modified.description: Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard, so they can come out sharper. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches_modified.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Use the system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you. Stories you watch to the end show as watched on this phone only, until that person posts a new one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Floating power button
patches_added.description: Adds a draggable quick-actions bubble to the main screen (profile IDs / receipts / pause toggles, copy your profile id, open Pdb Extras). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Quick → 'Show floating power button'.

patches_added.name: No profile-visitor limit
patches_added.description: Lifts Pdb's client-side cap of 3 profile-visitor views per hour (the 'slow down' sheet). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Limits → 'No profile-visitor limit'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is on.

patches_added.name: Show profile IDs on names
patches_added.description: Appends the numeric profile id (#1234567) after every profile name — Soul cards, chat headers, lists. Toggle: Pdb Extras → 'Show profile IDs on names'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is enabled, so the toggle works without rebuilding.

patches_modified.name: Auto not interested
patches_modified.description: Skips the reason popup and auto-submits when tapping Not Interested.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Blocks analytics requests sent to Instagram and Facebook servers.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Disables screenshot detection in direct messages and stories.

patches_modified.name: Download media
patches_modified.description: Adds ability to download posts, reels, stories and highlights

patches_modified.name: Download voice message
patches_modified.description: Enables ability to download voice messages

patches_modified.name: Filter stories
patches_modified.description: Hides categories of stories from the story tray.

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Hides Instants from DMs page.

patches_modified.name: Hide Threads profile button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Threads button from the profile page action bar (top right of the profile page).

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides ads in the feed and in the Following feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested content
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested reels and suggested accounts. Suggested stories are hidden by Filter stories.

patches_modified.name: Improve image viewing
patches_modified.description: Requests the maximum resolution images from the server.

patches_modified.name: Make ephemeral media permanent
patches_modified.description: Changes unexpired view once, view twice media to permanent view. Opening such media no longer sends Instagram a seen receipt, so it is still there after the chat refreshes.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens links in the system browser instead of the in-app browser.

patches_modified.name: Reorder menu options
patches_modified.description: Moves Interested and Not Interested to the top of the post menu.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize share links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from links shared out of the app.

patches_modified.name: Save deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a local copy of incoming DMs so ones the sender deletes stay readable. Messages are stored unencrypted in the app's private storage.

patches_added.name: Custom font
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show the app with the device system font or a custom TTF or OTF font file instead of YouTube Sans.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto
patches_modified.description: Bypasses certificate checks and restores YouTube Music Home recommendations, Library collections, and podcasts in Android Auto.
patches_modified.previous_description: Bypasses certificate checks and restores YouTube Music playlists and podcasts in Android Auto.

patches_modified.name: App refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate.

patches_modified.name: Change header
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

patches_modified.name: Change miniplayer color
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the miniplayer background color to match the fullscreen player.

patches_modified.name: Change start page
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

patches_modified.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches_modified.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved.

patches_modified.name: Crossfade
patches_modified.description: Adds a true dual-player crossfade between consecutive tracks.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. For mounted (root) installations the branding is applied while patching, because it cannot be changed from the app settings.

patches_modified.name: Disable DRC audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches_modified.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches_modified.name: Disable dislike redirection
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent skipping to the next track when the dislike button is pressed.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds support to download songs using the in-app download button, either with an external downloader app or inside YouTube Music.

patches_modified.name: Enable audio/video switch
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to switch between the audio and the video version of a track by redirecting videoId.

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging
patches_modified.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches_modified.name: Enable exclusive audio playback
patches_modified.description: Enables the option to play audio without video.

patches_modified.name: Enable forced miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to enable forced miniplayer when switching between music videos, podcasts, or songs.

patches_modified.name: Enable swipe to dismiss miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to enable dismissing the miniplayer by swiping down on it.

patches_modified.name: Force original audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches_modified.name: Force portrait orientation
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to keep the app in portrait orientation when the device is rotated.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the cast, history, notification, search, voice search, sound search, and Library New buttons.

patches_modified.name: Hide flyout menu components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide individual items from the player and queue flyout menus.

patches_modified.name: Hide layout components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches_modified.name: Hide music action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide action buttons under the player.

patches_modified.name: Jam queue sharing
patches_modified.description: Shares the host queue and playback controls through an authenticated Jam bridge. Root installation is not supported.

patches_modified.name: Media notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches_modified.name: Miniplayer previous and next buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show previous and next track buttons in the miniplayer.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide navigation bar, labels and buttons.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_modified.name: Play albums songs
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play the song version of album tracks instead of music videos.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the playback speed and pitch of tracks.

patches_modified.name: Playlist track tap action
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play only the tapped track of a playlist or album, or to add it to the queue, instead of replacing the queue with the whole playlist.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Remember repeat state
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the repeat state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches_modified.name: Remember shuffle state
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the shuffle state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of tracks with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Scrobbling
patches_modified.description: Adds options to add played tracks to Last.fm and ListenBrainz.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter

patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel

A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any story

patches_added.name: Media viewer black background
patches_added.description: Adds an option to use a black background behind images and videos in the media viewer, instead of the theme background color.

patches_added.name: Media viewer fade
patches_added.description: Adds an option to lower or remove the dark fade behind the caption when viewing images and videos.

patches_added.name: Redgifs audio
patches_added.description: Adds an option to play the original Redgifs video, which has audio, instead of Reddit's silent copy.

patches_added.name: Remember collapsed comments
patches_added.description: Adds an option to keep comments you collapsed collapsed when reopening a post.

patches_added.name: Show flairs in home feed
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show post flair badges in the home feed. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_removed.name: Show view count
patches_removed.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches_modified.name: App icon
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to select from the Reddit app icons available in the manifest.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches_modified.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Force system font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reddit search
patches_modified.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches_modified.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.

patches_modified.name: Start as guest
patches_modified.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes banner, interstitial, rewarded and app-open ads: every ad load is reported to the app as "no ad available", so screens that wait for an ad carry on without it. Also skips PairIP's Play license check that otherwise kills the app when it is not installed from Play. Playback and playlists are unchanged.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the Google Mobile Ads SDK and its mediation networks from starting, so the app's banner and interstitial ads never load, and skips PairIP's Play license check that otherwise kills the app when it is not installed from Play. Playback and playlists are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Disables banner, interstitial and rewarded ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables AppsFlyer event logging, app-logged Firebase Analytics events and Crashlytics exception reporting.

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the app's Pro plan. Features the BoxBox server grants by account (UserProfiles.isPro) may stay locked.

patches_modified.name: Brave Origin
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables feature toggle controls.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads

patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the banner ad and skips the ad consent form, which otherwise closes the app for free users who refuse consent.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads

patches_modified.description: Unlocks the premium version (removes ads and lifts premium limits).
