patches_added.description: Stops Truecaller from sending your saved contacts' numbers to its servers (chat contact discovery, friends' Premium status and the Call Assistant whitelist) and hides the contact editor's name suggestion upload. Contacts, dialer search and caller ID keep working. Truecaller Chat no longer finds which of your contacts use it, and with the Call Assistant your saved contacts are no longer whitelisted.

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Premium interface and the Premium features that are checked on the device. Features backed by Truecaller's servers (Call Assistant, family sharing, Who viewed / searched for me data, Identify AI, cloud call recording, fraud insurance, the verified badge) are reported as unavailable.
patches_modified.previous_description: Unlocks the Premium interface and the Premium features that are checked on the device. Features backed by Truecaller's servers (Call Assistant, family sharing, Who viewed / searched for me data, Identify AI, cloud call recording, fraud insurance, the verified badge) are not unlocked.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the 'notes_edit_banner' unit from utils/AdManager and the app-open ad from App$AppOpenAdManager. Both are gated on the single App.isAdFree() check, which normally depends on a VIP subscription.

patches_modified.description: Unlocks the VIP-only fonts, note backgrounds, stickers and drawing tools. The app checks entitlement entirely locally — there is no license server — so forcing the App.isVip() gate to return true unlocks everything, and stays unlocked even though BillingManager resets the underlying purchase flags from Play on every startup.

patches_removed.description: Sets the headset name SteamVR sees; optional, so it stays out of the recommended set. Builds: exact 2.0.23/5002363.

patches_removed.name: OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST
patches_removed.description: Asks OpenXR for the CPU and GPU BOOST hint at each session start; the headset still controls clocks and thermals, and unsupported ones continue without BOOST. No root needed; performance gain not yet measured. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek/steamlink-patches.

patches_removed.name: OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST (2.0.21/2.0.22)
patches_removed.description: Asks OpenXR for the CPU and GPU BOOST hint at each session start; the headset still controls clocks and thermals, and unsupported ones continue without BOOST. No root needed; performance gain not yet measured. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek/steamlink-patches.

patches_modified.name: Android XR native permission names
patches_modified.description: Swaps the built-in Oculus face and eye permission names for Android XR ones. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Swaps the app's built-in face and eye permission names to the ones Android XR needs. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches_modified.name: Appear on top (legacy)
patches_modified.description: Lets Steam Link draw its panel over other screens (legacy fallback). Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Legacy overlay fallback for older builds: lets Steam Link draw its panel over other screens.

patches_modified.name: Blue-noise dithering
patches_modified.description: Adds fine grain that hides color steps; center and background can be toggled. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds fine grain that hides harsh color steps, with separate on/off choices for the center and the background. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.

patches_modified.name: Change package name
patches_modified.description: Renames the app so it can install next to the original. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Renames the app so the patched Steam Link can install next to the original. Builds: 5001712 to 5002244.

patches_modified.name: Controller velocity frame
patches_modified.description: Fixes thrown-object directions by rotating controller speeds into the frame SteamVR expects. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363. Angular velocity is local to the streamed pose on 2.0.23/5002363 and in the base space on older builds; measured on 2.0.23/5002363. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.
patches_modified.previous_description: Fixes thrown-object directions by rotating controller speeds into the frame SteamVR expects. Builds: 2.0.23, angular velocity is reported local to the streamed pose; 2.0.20 - 2.0.22, it is reported in the base space. Angles measured on 2.0.23/5002363. Needs: nothing. The root Velocity Frame and Steam Link Pose Time modules do not run while this layer is loaded. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches_modified.name: Device identity
patches_modified.description: Reports the Galaxy XR headset identity to SteamVR (model xrvst2ue). Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sets the headset name SteamVR sees, with Meta Quest Pro as the recommended profile. Builds: 5001712 to 5002244.

patches_modified.name: Force HMD initialization gates
patches_modified.description: Removes 2 startup checks that can stop headset tracking. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes 2 headset startup checks so tracking starts even when the app's own checks would stop it. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches_modified.name: Force lobby permission-state gate
patches_modified.description: Skips a lobby permission check so the room screen loads. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Skips a lobby permission check so the room screen loads normally. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches_modified.name: Force stream XR gates
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes 3 XR checks on the streaming path so video can start. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches_modified.name: GXR face and tongue bridge
patches_modified.description: Installs the VRCFT face bridge on legacy builds; on 2.0.23/5002363 it only adds tongue transport. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363. Valve's own expressions and tongue-out keep working.
patches_modified.previous_description: Face and tongue feed for the VRCFT module: the face bridge on 5001712/5001812/5001968/5002244, tongue out/left/right/up/down slots on 2.0.23/5002363; Valve's own expressions and tongue-out keep working.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR SteamVR driver (galaxyxr)
patches_modified.description: Sets Galaxy XR names in SteamVR; needs the PC-side Galaxy XR VRLink Setup. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sets Galaxy XR headset and controller names in SteamVR, replacing the Meta Quest Pro spoof. Builds: 5001712 to 5002363. Needs: Galaxy XR VRLink Setup on the PC, or controllers show no model. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek/steamlink-patches.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_modified.description: Permission-free high-resolution fix that leaves renderer formats, including future RGB10_A2, untouched. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Permission-free high-resolution fix: adds a small Android-surface trigger and leaves the renderer's own formats, including future RGB10_A2, untouched. No image copy. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363.

patches_modified.name: Microphone input preset
patches_modified.description: Switches microphone capture mode; Voice Recognition tested best. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Switches the microphone's capture mode; Voice Recognition tested clearest and loudest on Galaxy XR. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.

patches_modified.name: Network Optimizations
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps streaming smooth after Wi-Fi hiccups: lost packets are re-requested, recent video frames are kept, and bigger buffers absorb bursts; headset verification still pending. Builds: 2.0.23/5002363 only.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration

patches_modified.previous_description: Requests hand, eye, face, microphone and Bluetooth permissions at startup on older builds; battery settings and the splash are separate patches.

patches_modified.name: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)

patches_added.name: Brave NTP four-column tiles
patches_added.description: Experimental version-unpinned patch (issue #24): keeps the new-tab pinned and most-visited tiles in a four-column grid that extends downwards, the same layout Brave uses with no background image, and keeps that layout when a background image is enabled. Neutralizes the "brave.new_tab_page.show_background_image" gate in the NTP builder that otherwise forces the tiles into a single horizontally scrolling row. Default off.

patches_modified.name: Brave AMOLED theme
patches_modified.description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). Raised surfaces — buttons, cards, sheets and the Material You container ladder — can take their own surface color instead of one flat black, so the UI keeps an elevation step like Material 3. Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+; leaving that force off keeps the Material You roles and low-lStar selectors untouched. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.
